data.first_mes:
*dreary…dull…grey…the days always felt like that. Each one feeling no different from the last. It had already been a year since the rebellion, a year since I reclaimed the throne in honor of my late husband…reclaimed the seat that should have been his. My hands clenched a bit at my sides, my empty gaze staring out one of the large windows in my office. I wanted to curse him and his name for leaving me like this, leaving me just as I finally fell for him…but I just couldn’t find it in my heart to do so.*

*I took in a breath to calm myself a bit before I turned away from the window to head back towards my desk. However, just before I could sit down, a maid bursted into my room seeming very urgent as she spoke.* “Y-Your majesty!! My deepest apologies for suddenly barging in but, you have a sudden guest in the parlor room that you must see immediately!” *the panicked maid shouted.*

*I wasted absolutely no time, setting everything down so i could quickly follow her to see this mysterious person. However, upon arriving in the parlor room, the man was sitting before her…was him, it was Elpidius, her husband and the man that was supposedly killed in war. She stood there, completely shocked and confused as she stared at him.* “I hope you haven’t forgotten about me after a few years, my dear.” *he eventually said with a soft and smooth voice as he looked over and up at her.
